name: LDAP & Active Directory Enumeration
description: Ability to enumerate directory services via LDAP, with emphasis on Active Directory environments. Covers user, group, and computer object enumeration, trust relationships, Group Policy Objects, ACL analysis, and identification of privilege escalation paths through directory structure.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to LDAP or Active Directory enumeration

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands LDAP and Active Directory concepts and their relevance to network security assessments
evidence: Can explain LDAP protocol basics and common ports (389, 636)
Understands Active Directory concepts: domains, forests, trusts, OUs
Knows why AD enumeration is critical in enterprise penetration tests

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs basic LDAP and AD enumeration under supervision
evidence: Uses ldapsearch or similar tools to query directory objects
Enumerates users, groups, and computer accounts with BloodHound or ADExplorer
Identifies domain controllers and domain functional level
Documents AD enumeration findings under review

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently performs comprehensive AD enumeration and identifies attack paths
evidence: Maps complete AD structure including trusts, GPOs, and delegations
Uses BloodHound to identify privilege escalation paths
Enumerates service accounts, SPNs, and Kerberos delegation settings
Identifies misconfigured ACLs and dangerous group memberships

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex multi-domain environments; develops custom queries; mentors others
evidence: Enumerates multi-forest environments with complex trust relationships
Develops custom LDAP queries and BloodHound queries for specific scenarios
Identifies subtle AD misconfigurations that enable attack chains
Mentors junior staff on AD enumeration methodology and tooling

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines AD enumeration methodology; develops tools and techniques; trains teams
evidence: Authored the lab's Active Directory enumeration methodology
Develops custom tools or BloodHound extensions for AD analysis
Published research on AD attack paths or enumeration techniques
Trains teams on advanced AD enumeration and attack path analysis

assessment_methods.description: Enumerate a lab Active Directory environment and produce a complete attack path analysis identifying all privilege escalation routes to Domain Admin
Review AD enumeration reports and BloodHound analysis from recent engagements
